([[Trenton, New Jersey]]) | college = *[[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU]] (2020–2023) *[[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] (2023–2025) | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] ([[2024–25 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|2025]]) }} '''Jamir Kamal Watkins''' (born July 6, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]] and the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==Early life and high school== Raised in [[Trenton, New Jersey]], Watkins attended [[Trenton Catholic Academy]] in [[Mercer County, New Jersey]]. Coming out of high school, Watkins was rated as a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]].{{cite web |last1=Epps |first1=Wayne |title=VCU adds third player in 2020 recruiting class, with commitment of small forward Jamir Watkins |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/plus/vcu-adds-third-player-in-2020-recruiting-class-with-commitment-of-small-forward-jamir-watkins/article_912df4a0-d621-11e9-867d-8b8f0799af70.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=March 1, 2025}} Jamir was born to Tonya Watkins and has a sister. His major is Social Sciences. ==College career== === VCU === As a freshman in 2020-21, Watkins appeared in 26 games with two starts, where he averaged 7.2 points, 2.6 rebounds, 0.7 assists, and 0.9 steals per game.{{cite web |title=Jamir Watkins 2020-21 Game Logs |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/jamir-watkins-1/gamelog/2021 |website=Sports Reference |access-date=March 1, 2025}} He missed the entire 2021-22 season due to a knee injury.{{cite web |last1=Schultz |first1=Nick |title=Report: Florida State transfer guard Jamir Watkins to visit St. John's, Michigan |url=https://www.on3.com/news/jamir-watkins-florida-state-transfer-guard-visit-st-johns-michigan-portal/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 1, 2025}} On December 17, 2023, Watkins scored 22 points versus the [[2022–23 Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball team|Northern Illinois]].{{cite web |last1=Pearrell |first1=Tim |title=VCU sophomore Jamir Watkins starting to show ‘high ceiling’ |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/schools/virginia-commonwealth-university/vcu-sophomore-jamir-watkins-starting-to-show-high-ceiling/article_d0fcfa32-b6e1-11ed-9a51-a7b5e5b60957.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=March 1, 2025}} On January 20, 2023, he scored a game-high 15 points, while also adding ten rebounds, two assists, two steals, and two blocks, in a win over [[2022–23 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]].{{cite web |last1=Teel |first1=David |title=Teel: Jamir Watkins' best game as a collegian ignites VCU's win at Richmond |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/schools/virginia-commonwealth-university/teel-jamir-watkins-best-game-as-a-collegian-ignites-vcus-win-at-richmond/article_48957bcc-993d-11ed-8be7-cbdd4375ae06.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=March 1, 2025}} In the first round of the A-10 conference tournament, Watkins scored 11 points, while also tallying six rebounds, two assists, and three blocks.{{cite web |last1=Pearrell |first1=Tim |title=Jamir Watkins seems to be elevating more for VCU as Rams head into A-10 semifinals |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/schools/virginia-commonwealth-university/jamir-watkins-seems-to-be-elevating-more-for-vcu-as-rams-head-into-a-10/article_bfe10662-bef7-11ed-8c46-d7f8a1bf9dcc.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=March 1, 2025}} In the 2022-23 season, he averaged 9.5 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 1.2 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=Kassim |first1=Ehsan |title=Florida State men's basketball adds VCU SF from transfer portal, second addition |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2023/04/15/fsu-mens-basketball-vcu-sf-jamir-watkins-commits-to-seminoles/70118847007/ |website=Tallahassee Democrat |access-date=March 1, 2025}} After the season, Watkins entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Barber |first1=Mike |title=VCU transfer Jamir Watkins leads Florida State into Virginia game |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/vcu-transfer-jamir-watkins-leads-florida-state-into-virginia-game/article_6bf8c302-c700-11ee-b26d-33459bb9b9fe.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=March 1, 2025}} === Florida State === Watkins transferred to play for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. On January 23, 2024, he notched 27 points and 11 rebounds in a win over [[2023–24 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]].{{cite web |last1=Kassim |first1=Ehsan |title=FSU men's basketball continues hot run with dominant second half win over Syracuse |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2024/01/23/jamir-watkins-career-night-leads-fsu-to-major-road-victory-over-syracuse/72331182007/ |website=Tallahassee Democrat |access-date=March 1, 2025}} In the second round of the 2024 ACC tournament, Watkins scored a career-high 34 points with 11 rebounds and four steals.{{cite web |last1=Schultz |first1=Nick |title=Jamir Watkins announces plans to withdraw from NCAA transfer portal, return to Florida State |url=https://www.on3.com/college/florida-state-seminoles/news/jamir-watkins-withdraw-ncaa-transfer-portal-return-florida-state/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 1, 2025}} During the 2023-24 season, he started all 32 games for Florida State, where he averaged 5.6 points a game, six rebounds, and 2.8 assists, while also adding 64 steals and 28 blocks, en route to being named an all-ACC honorable mention. After the season, Watkins declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]], but eventually withdrew and returned to Florida State.{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=Liam |title=FSU basketball's Jamir Watkins had many options in offseason. Here's why he came back |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/2024/10/18/fsu-basketballs-jamir-watkins-leadership-role-leonard-hamilton/75592728007/ |website=Tallahassee Democrat |access-date=March 1, 2025}} On November 9, 2024, Watkins scored 30 points, while also adding six rebounds and an assist in a win over [[2024–25 Rice Owls men's basketball team|Rice]].{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=Liam |title=FSU men's basketball's Jamir Watkins scores 30 points in 73-65 road win over Rice |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2024/11/10/fsu-mens-basketball-moves-to-2-0-after-30-points-from-jamir-watkins/76171090007/ |website=Tallahassee Democrat |access-date=March 1, 2025}} On December 14, 2024, he dropped 29 points, four rebounds, five assists, a steal, and a block in a win over [[2024–25 Tulane Green Wave men's basketball team|Tulane]].{{cite web |last1=Derryberry |first1=Jace |title=NBA Draft: Florida State's Jamir Watkins Continues to Build on Plug-and-Play Potential |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-florida-state-jamir-watkins-continues-to-build-on-plug-and-play-potential |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=March 1, 2025}} == References == {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://seminoles.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jamir-watkins/7308 Florida State Seminoles bio] *[https://vcuathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jamir-watkins/4668 VCU Rams bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Watkins, Jamir}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Trenton, New Jersey]] [[Category:Florida State Seminoles men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Trenton Catholic Academy alumni]] [[Category:VCU Rams men's basketball players]]
